parent_objective: audit M2042 no-rerun outcome localization and choose repair or comparison route
blocked_by: M2042 found no comparison-ready or candidate-support slices and broad offtrack dominance
supersedes: direct ranking from localized low-support smoke outcomes

public_gates: M2043 must audit M2042 result class and count reproduction
M2043 must interpret zero comparison-ready candidates and broad offtrack dominance
M2043 must choose task-quality repair, candidate qualification, synthesis, or stop
M2043 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the no-rerun localization result and chooses the next route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no new rollout ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2042 did not reproduce M2039 outcome counts
stop if localization artifacts are incomplete
stop if the audit cannot choose between repair and comparison
stop if the audit would rank controller families from low-support smoke rows
fallback_plan: route to task-quality repair if offtrack dominance is broad and no comparison candidates exist
route to candidate qualification if supported slices exist
route to branch synthesis if the next route is ambiguous
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2042 writes no-rerun localization artifacts and names M2043 as next blocker

training_stage.stage_objective: controlled routing-smoke outcome localization result audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not run new rollout during audit
do not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2043 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for the selected route
next_stage_criteria: supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2043 audits outcome localization only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2043.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no candidate slice exists, route to repair or synthesis instead of ranking.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns M2042 localization into a route decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can determine whether routing-smoke evidence needs task-quality repair before any comparison
must_synthesize_if: M2043 cannot choose a single next route
M2043 would route to another localization without new evidence

hypothesis: M2042 localization can be audited into a single repair or comparison route without new rollout.
success_criteria: M2042 result class and outcome count reproduction are audited
comparison-ready and candidate-support counts are interpreted
no new rollout ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new rollout or ranking is performed

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit runs/m2042_paper_route_controlled_routing_smoke_outcome_localization artifacts and write M2043 result audit

decision_rule: M2043 passes if it audits M2042 and chooses a bounded next route without overclaiming.
